summary: BE - Incorrect Payment Amount Displayed When Invoice Is Paid Using Credit Balance
reported_issue: When an invoice is paid using a customer's existing credit balance, the Payment entry shows the remaining credit instead of the invoice amount actually applied. Example: $10.00 invoice paid from a $14.18 credit balance recorded the payment as $4.18 (the remaining credit) rather than $10.00.
expected_after_fix: The Payment row should show the invoice amount paid (e.g. $10.00); the remaining credit ($4.18) should stay on the account as credit.
steps_i_followed: As admin, opened customer 'new test' (account a3b829a5...) which had two unpaid invoices of $1,078.71 each.

Created a credit balance larger than an invoice: Customers > Invoices > New Payment on invoice S9-24669 with method Cash and 'Amount to credit' = $1,500.00 (Payment amount $2,578.71). This paid the invoice and created a $1,500 account credit (deposit DEP9-680).

Paid the remaining unpaid invoice S9-24661 ($1,078.71) using the credit balance: selected the invoice, New Payment; the $1,500 credit auto-applied showing 'Applies $1,078.71 - $421.29 remaining', Payment amount $0.00, and submitted (button 'Create Credit').
Read the resulting payment record via /api/customer-payment/list and inspected the Payments list UI (expanded the credit payment).
actual_now: The credit-balance payment records the INVOICE AMOUNT APPLIED, not the remaining credit. API record for the new payment: applied_credits = -1078.71, credits[]=DEP-680 applied 1078.71; invoice S9-24661 is now marked 'Paid'. In the Payments UI the expanded payment shows 'Invoice S9-24661 $1,078.71 Paid' and 'Deposit DEP9-680 Excess Payment -$1,078.71 Applied'. The $421.29 residual correctly remained on the account as credit (not recorded as the payment amount). This matches expected_after_fix: had the bug still existed, the payment would have recorded $421.29 (remaining credit) instead of $1,078.71 (invoice amount).
notes: Re-test of prior NEEDS-INFO. Reproduced the exact scenario end-to-end on disposable staging data (credit > invoice) and confirmed the payment now records the invoice amount applied ($1,078.71), with the surplus retained as credit ($421.29). Bug does not reproduce.
